test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Awareness (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched regarding scheme and its implementing ministry?

options.text: Mission Shakti - Ministry of Home Affairs

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Samarth Scheme - Ministry of Textiles**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Samarth Scheme**, also known as the **Scheme for Capacity Building in Textile Sector (SCBTS)**, is implemented by the **Ministry of Textiles**.
 
• The primary aim of the scheme is to provide **skill development and training** to workers in the textile sector.
 
• It is designed to meet the needs of the **industry**, promote sustainable livelihoods, and enhance employment opportunities for youth.
 
• The scheme targets sectors such as **apparel, handlooms, handicrafts, and power looms**.
 
• The initiative aligns with the government's vision of **"Skill India"** to create a skilled workforce in the textile industry.
 
• Under this scheme, the government partners with **state governments, industry players, and training institutions** for effective implementation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **PM-JANMAN - Ministry of Rural Development**__

 __
 
• The option is incorrect as **PM-JANMAN** does not refer to any known scheme under the **Ministry of Rural Development**.
 
• It could be a confusion with schemes like **PM Jan Dhan Yojana**, which is implemented by the **Ministry of Finance** and aims to promote financial inclusion.
 
 
 
• **Mission Shakti - Ministry of Home Affairs**__
 __
 
• The option is incorrect. **Mission Shakti** is not implemented by the **Ministry of Home Affairs**.
 
• It is a government initiative aimed at enhancing **women's safety and empowerment**, and is implemented by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development**.
 
 
 
• **PM MITRA - Ministry of Agriculture**__
 
 
• The option is incorrect as **PM MITRA** (Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel Parks) is implemented by the **Ministry of Textiles**.
 
• It aims to develop integrated textile parks to boost domestic textile production and exports.
